backend.invocation:
set -euo pipefail

deselect_args=()
quarantine_count=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue
  node_id="${line%% \#*}"
  if [[ "$node_id" == "$line" ]]; then
    echo "Quarantine row is missing its reason: $line" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  deselect_args+=("--deselect=$node_id")
  ((quarantine_count += 1))
done < .github/ci/backend-quarantine.txt

if [[ "$quarantine_count" -ne 12 ]]; then
  echo "Expected 12 quarantined nodes, found $quarantine_count" >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p test-results
pytest_output="test-results/backend-suite.log"
python scripts/run_pytest.py --timeout-seconds 2100 --grace-seconds 20 -- --ignore=tests/integration --durations=25 --junitxml=test-results/backend-suite.xml "${deselect_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$pytest_output"

if ! grep -Eq '(^|, )12 deselected(,| in )' "$pytest_output"; then
  echo "Pytest did not report exactly 12 deselected tests." >&2
  exit 1
fi
